articles.title: Morgan Stanley’s Jonas: Physical AI Could Multiply Global GDP
articles.description: Morgan Stanley’s Adam Jonas says the convergence of AI and robotics could have a transformational impact on the global economy, potentially multiplying GDP as physical AI spreads across transportation, manufacturing and everyday life. He discusses why the robotics race is inseparable from rebuilding US manufacturing, where China holds an advantage across key supply chains, and how Tesla and SpaceX could play complementary roles in a future where billions of connected robots perform more AI inference at the edge. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
